_readme: External things the harness depends on, pinned. `mode` is reference (installed from upstream, never edited), vendored (copied into skills/ with upstream license), or cli. `ref` is the upstream tag or full 40-character commit SHA verified on `checked` (the skills CLI cannot install a short SHA). `clis` entries with `global: true` are npm packages that `uskn-harness sync` installs globally through mise at `version` (plus `bundle`); `bin` is what ends up on PATH. `skills` entries with `via` are installed by `sync`: `via: skills` through the skills CLI pinned in `clis`, `via: impeccable` from the release asset checked against `sha256`. Update refs deliberately and record why in an ADR or change.

mise.role: Node and Python for hooks and CLIs; shims work in non-interactive shells

jq.via: mise when the OS has no jq
jq.role: JSON parsing in hooks and the installer

skills.role: installs the `skills` entries with `via: skills` as `npx -y skills@<version> add '<source>#<ref>@<name>' -g -a claude-code -y`. Global installs are recorded in $XDG_STATE_HOME/skills/.skill-lock.json, else ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json; sync reinstalls and doctor warns when the recorded `ref` differs from deps.json

textlint.role: computational sensor for Japanese prose; config skills/ja-writing/textlintrc.json with the prh dictionary skills/ja-writing/prh.yml, run by the textlint-check hook and by make verify

designmd.role: DESIGN.md lint / diff / export / spec; used by ui-guidelines and by make verify on templates/repo/DESIGN.md

agent-style.role: 21 English writing rules (CC BY 4.0 + MIT): `agent-style rules`, `agent-style review --audit-only`; used by en-writing. `enable` is not used (the user layer CLAUDE.md is managed by the harness)

grilling.role: mandatory interview before any spec decision

handoff.role: compact a conversation into a handoff document

writing-for-agents.role: rules for writing SKILL.md and AGENTS.md

humanizer.role: English prose de-AI pass; accepts voice samples. en-writing asks for its embedded mode, which returns only the final text
humanizer.status: installed globally; en-writing calls it as the final pass

expo-skills.role: React Native / Expo guidance for monolith
expo-skills.status: project-level install in Expo repositories (phase 4); not installed globally

frontend-design.role: fallback UI guidance for a new web surface that has no DESIGN.md yet (ui-guidelines step 4)

impeccable.role: UI commands (audit, critique, polish, harden, adapt, ...). init / document / extract / doctor are not used: DESIGN.md follows the Google spec, PRODUCT.md comes from templates/repo. Skill tags (skill-v*) and CLI tags (cli-v*) are independent, and the CLI's `install` fetches the latest skill unless IMPECCABLE_BUNDLE_PATH names a local zip. A local zip skips the CLI's signature check, so sync checks it against `sha256` first. Every install writes the agents in `remove_agents`; sync deletes them

changes: skill references renamed to harness skill names
verify convention named as the GREEN command
CREATION-LOG.md and test-*.md (skill tests) not vendored
verify convention and the verify-gate Stop hook under Key Patterns
OpenSpec tasks.md in the requirements check
worktrees stay inside the project root (write guard)
clean-baseline check uses the verify convention
